conf.description: NetApp ONTAP EMS event notifications, api-pull (REST Collector JSON from GET /api/support/ems/events): map JSON keys to ECS, keeping the structured parameters array bounded as a nested field rather than promoting keys to the top level.

conf.comment: NetApp ONTAP EMS, api-pull. No framing detection needed - message name/severity/node/parameters arrive as typed JSON. Shares the logs-netapp_ontap.ems data stream with the syslog-kv and webhook forms. Scope the poll by message-name prefix at the API per recommendations.direct.cribl (Collector/API config, not pipeline logic - see README).

functions.description: Parse the JSON EMS event record
Map JSON keys to ECS and custom fields; keep parameters as a nested array
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
